1.title: Former Kentucky Governor Is Arrested Amid Child Support Battle
1.summary: Matthew Bevin, the former Republican governor, was held in contempt for failing to abide by court orders to file financial disclosure documents, a lawyer said.

2.title: Pentagon Subjects Roughly 50 Members of the Joint Staff to Polygraph Tests in Expanded Leak Hunt
2.summary: The aggressive effort comes in the wake of news reports about the military’s diminished stocks of crucial munitions as the U.S. fights Iran.

3.title: Judge Will Not Block Pentagon Move to Fire Stars and Stripes Journalists
3.summary: A judge appeared skeptical of the journalists’ arguments that they were fired for coverage of worsening conditions on a Navy warship.

4.title: UN votes to adopt new world map to reflect Africa's true size
4.summary: The Togo-sponsored resolution was backed by 164 nations - with the US as the only nation to vote against it.

5.title: Germany's far-right AfD bids for first taste of power in eastern vote
5.summary: If it wins an outright majority in Saxony-Anhalt, it would be the first time a far-right party has held state-level power in Germany since World War Two.

6.title: Mistrial declared in Lindsay Clancy murder case, after jury deadlocks
6.summary: The mistrial now puts the murder case - and Clancy's future - in limbo as to whether she will be held criminally liable in the deaths of her three kids.
